entities.summary: Carlos, a notable figure in the history of Venezuela, associated with Punto Fijo Democracy and the Oil Boom (1976–1989). Preceded by Oil industry nationalized — PDVSA created — January 1, 1976 and Era of 'Saudi Venezuela' — massive oil-fueled spending — 1974. Their legacy influenced Chávez wins presidential election by landslide — December 1998 and El Caracazo — mass uprising and military repression — February 27, 1989.
